trust_decision.summary: decodeAppleToken decides whether an Apple id_token is authentic by jwt.verify against Apple's JWKS key, but takes the allowed algorithm list from the attacker-controlled token header (alg) instead of pinning RS256.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'Apple Sign-in authentication bypass'; apple_auth.ts is the only Apple token verifier and line 58 is its only jwt.verify call.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/auth/apple-redirect (+ /vercel/apple-redirect, /apple-redirect-localhost) via handleAppleWebAuth, and POST /api/mobile-auth/sign-in and /sign-up with provider=APPLE
fix_sites.module_kind: auth router helper (same module the report points to)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: None that holds: all five routes funnel through the single decodeAppleToken function, so one edit closes them; Google verification is delegated to google-auth-library OAuth2Client.verifyIdToken (packages/api/src/routers/auth/google_auth.ts:77-80, 119-122) and does not use header alg.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Genuine Apple RS256 id_tokens must still verify, with issuer and both audiences (app.omnivore.work, app.omnivore) accepted; key selection by header kid must stay.

O6_input_shapes: token header alg value (any non-RS256 alg, chosen by caller) — replaced by fixed ['RS256'] list

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a hand-rolled Google web id_token verifier (jwks-rsa + jwt.verify with header alg) mirroring decodeAppleToken, e.g. for the web gauth-redirect flow
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The Apple path already shows the maintainers' hand-rolled JWKS+jsonwebtoken pattern; a maintainer avoiding google-auth-library for one flow could copy it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an Android Apple callback that decodes/verifies id_token server-side through its own copy of the verify call
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This Android-only Apple route already exists and currently only redirects the token; a legacy/android-specific verifier there would sit in another file and be arguable as 'Android WebView only'.

O9_family: CWE-347 improper signature verification: JWT algorithm taken from token header (algorithm confusion)

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + yarn workspaces (lerna monorepo), jsonwebtoken ^9.0.3, jwks-rsa ^2.0.3 (packages/api/package.json:93-94)
O10_build.project_tests: None for Apple auth: no file under packages/api/test references decodeAppleToken or apple_auth; api tests use mocha.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Pin algorithms: ['RS256'] in jwt.verify at apple_auth.ts:58 — which is also the complete published fix.

out_of_scope_notes: apple_auth.ts:50-51 destructures jwt.decode(...).header outside the try block, so a non-JWT token throws before the try (robustness, not this advisory).
apple_auth.ts:212 builds a redirect URL with unencoded name/username from the Apple user body (unrelated).
unverified: Whether jsonwebtoken 9.x actually rejects HS*/none with an RSA PEM key (asymmetric-key checks) — determines real exploitability; not run.
offline_after_build: verification fetches JWKS from appleid.apple.com (apple_auth.ts:25-29); offline tests would need a nock/stub of jwks-rsa — not checked.
